description: This file contains abstract base class unit tests for a custom Grain Directory implementation in Orleans, testing registration, lookup, overwrite, and unregister functionalities.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing custom Orleans Grain Directory implementations, providing common test cases for registration, lookup, overwrite, and unregister operations.

methods.name: RegisterLookupUnregisterLookup
methods.description: Tests registering a grain address, looking it up, and unregistering it, verifying the expected behavior.

methods.name: DoNotOverwriteEntry
methods.description: Ensures that registering a grain address does not overwrite an existing entry unless explicitly intended.

methods.name: OverwriteEntryIfMatch
methods.description: Tests overwriting an existing grain address entry only when the previous address matches the expected one.

methods.name: DoNotDeleteDifferentActivationIdEntry
methods.description: Verifies that unregistering an entry with a different activation ID does not delete the existing entry.

methods.name: LookupNotFound
methods.description: Checks that lookup returns null for a grain ID that does not exist.
